title: GTA 6 reportedly played using Neuralink brain chip in new video
excerpt: "Is this the future?" asks a man reportedly playing the world's most popular video game with his brain.
content_html:
The official Neuralink X account recently shared a video of a man appearing to play Grand Theft Auto VI with a Neuralink device and, just one day later, it's already racked up more than five million views:

This Tweet is currently unavailable. It might be loading or has been removed.

In the remarkable video, a man streaming GTA VI narrates how he's performing in-game actions — including piloting a boat and a plane and engaging in hand-to-hand combat and gunfights — without a controller. 

He describes the mental manipulations necessary to control the character as both "easy and hard," before he goes on to describe the sensation of "tapping [his] ring finger" to throw a punch: "Bam! Look at that: that's what a ring finger can do in GTA."

While getting a pontoon plane to take off in the game, the man goes on to describe how the researchers added "extra buttons," which included the mental sensations of using his foot or, to pull the nose of the plane up, to slide his right hand forward, "almost like the mouse motion."
